source_text: 1Hero, what a pleasant surprise.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.1Hero, what a pleasant surprise.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.1Hero, what a pleasant surprise."

translation: 1Hero, co za miła niespodzianka.

source_text: I heard you were looking for me, Commissioner Kimura. Something about a new case?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I heard you were looking for me, Commissioner Kimura. Something about a new case?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I heard you were looking for me, Commissioner Kimura. Something about a new case?"

translation: Słyszałam, że mnie szukałeś, komisarz Kimura. Chodzi o nową sprawę?

source_text: So where were you? Your co-worker told me you were out, but he didn’t know why.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.So where were you? Your co-worker told me you were out, but he didn’t know why.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.So where were you? Your co-worker told me you were out, but he didn’t know why."

translation: Więc gdzie byłeś? Twój współpracownik mówił, że wyszedłeś, ale nie wiedział dlaczego.

source_text: Oh, uh, I was out working a case.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Oh, uh, I was out working a case.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Oh, uh, I was out working a case."

translation: Och, yyy, prowadziłem sprawę.

source_text: What case?

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.What case?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.What case?"

translation: Jaką sprawę?

source_text: The Wilkes case.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.The Wilkes case.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.The Wilkes case."

translation: Sprawę Wilkesa.

source_text: I thought Wilkes died of a heart attack.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.I thought Wilkes died of a heart attack.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.I thought Wilkes died of a heart attack."

translation: Myślałam, że Wilkes zmarł na zawał serca.

source_text: I think there’s more to it than that.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I think there’s more to it than that.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I think there’s more to it than that."

translation: Myślę, że kryje się za tym coś więcej.

source_text: You could say I’m following a hunch.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You could say I’m following a hunch.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You could say I’m following a hunch."

translation: Można powiedzieć, że idę za przeczuciem.

source_text: A hunch? Do you often follow hunches when working cases?

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.A hunch? Do you often follow hunches when working cases?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.A hunch? Do you often follow hunches when working cases?"

translation: Przeczuciem? Często podążasz za przeczuciami, prowadząc sprawy?

source_text: It’s part of being a detective.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’s part of being a detective.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’s part of being a detective."

translation: To część bycia detektywem.

source_text: Sometimes things don’t feel right about a case. I have to figure out if there’s something more to those feelings.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Sometimes things don’t feel right about a case. I have to figure out if there’s something more to those feelings.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Sometimes things don’t feel right about a case. I have to figure out if there’s something more to those feelings."

translation: Czasem coś mi nie gra w sprawie. Muszę sprawdzić, czy za tym przeczuciem kryje się coś więcej.

source_text: Hopefully not wasting department resources, I’m sure.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.Hopefully not wasting department resources, I’m sure.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.Hopefully not wasting department resources, I’m sure."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że nie marnujesz zasobów wydziału.

source_text: Oh, of course not.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Oh, of course not.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Oh, of course not."

translation: Och, oczywiście, że nie.

source_text: So what can I do for you, commissioner?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.So what can I do for you, commissioner?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.So what can I do for you, commissioner?"

translation: Więc co mogę dla pani zrobić, pani komisarz?

source_text: I guess you could say I’m following a hunch of my own.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.I guess you could say I’m following a hunch of my own.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.I guess you could say I’m following a hunch of my own."

translation: Chyba można powiedzieć, że ja też podążam za własnym przeczuciem.

source_text: I’m thinking of offering you an opportunity.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.I’m thinking of offering you an opportunity.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.I’m thinking of offering you an opportunity."

translation: Myślę, żeby zaproponować ci pewną okazję.

source_text: I’m glad you’re eager.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.I’m glad you’re eager.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.I’m glad you’re eager."

translation: Cieszę się, że jesteś chętny.

source_text: But it’s getting late in the day now, and we’ll need some time to go over it.

structure.raw_value: AdSaOp.But it’s getting late in the day now, and we’ll need some time to go over it.
structure.script_literal: "AdSaOp.But it’s getting late in the day now, and we’ll need some time to go over it."

translation: Ale robi się późno, a będziemy potrzebować czasu, by to omówić.

source_text: Oh, sure. Maybe tomorrow?

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Oh, sure. Maybe tomorrow?
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Oh, sure. Maybe tomorrow?"

translation: Och, jasne. Może jutro?

source_text: How about we discuss it over dinner? Say, at my place, around 6pm?

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.How about we discuss it over dinner? Say, at my place, around 6pm?
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.How about we discuss it over dinner? Say, at my place, around 6pm?"

translation: Może omówimy to przy kolacji? Powiedzmy, u mnie, około 18:00?

source_text: Dinner? At your place?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Dinner? At your place?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Dinner? At your place?"

translation: Kolacja? U pani?

source_text: Uh, sure, that sounds great.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Uh, sure, that sounds great.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Uh, sure, that sounds great."

translation: Yyy, jasne, brzmi świetnie.

source_text: Excellent. Let me give you the address.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.Excellent. Let me give you the address.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.Excellent. Let me give you the address."

translation: Doskonale. Podam ci adres.

source_text: Oh, that’s okay, I know where you live.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Oh, that’s okay, I know where you live.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Oh, that’s okay, I know where you live."

translation: Och, nie trzeba, wiem, gdzie pani mieszka.

source_text: You’re not stalking me, are you?

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.You’re not stalking me, are you?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.You’re not stalking me, are you?"

translation: Nie śledzisz mnie chyba?

source_text: Oh, no, not at all!

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Oh, no, not at all!
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Oh, no, not at all! "

translation: Och, nie, skądże!

source_text: It’s just one of the fancier residences in town, and you do have a high profile. People talk.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.It’s just one of the fancier residences in town, and you do have a high profile. People talk.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.It’s just one of the fancier residences in town, and you do have a high profile. People talk."

translation: To po prostu jedna z bardziej eleganckich rezydencji w mieście, a pani ma wysoki profil. Ludzie gadają.

source_text: A perfect excuse, but being stalked by a handsome young man might not be such a bad thing.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.A perfect excuse, but being stalked by a handsome young man might not be such a bad thing.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.A perfect excuse, but being stalked by a handsome young man might not be such a bad thing."

translation: Doskonała wymówka, ale bycie śledzoną przez przystojnego młodzieńca może nie być takie złe.

source_text: Then I’ll see you this evening.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.Then I’ll see you this evening.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.Then I’ll see you this evening."

translation: Więc do zobaczenia dziś wieczorem.

source_text: Oh, and I take it you’ll be wearing something…nicer, for dinner.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.Oh, and I take it you’ll be wearing something…nicer, for dinner.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.Oh, and I take it you’ll be wearing something…nicer, for dinner."

translation: I zakładam, że włożysz coś… ładniejszego na kolację.

source_text: Oh, umm, sure thing.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Oh, umm, sure thing.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Oh, umm, sure thing. "

translation: Och, yyy, oczywiście.

source_text: Fantastic, 1Hero. Don’t be late.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Fantastic, 1Hero. Don’t be late.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Fantastic, 1Hero. Don’t be late."

translation: Fantastycznie, 1Hero. Nie spóźnij się.

source_text: Absolutely. I’ll see you then, commissioner.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Absolutely. I’ll see you then, commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Absolutely. I’ll see you then, commissioner."

translation: Absolutnie. Do zobaczenia, pani komisarz.

source_text: Wow, a dinner meeting with the commissioner! This could be great.

structure.raw_value: McHaAg^.Wow, a dinner meeting with the commissioner! This could be great.
structure.script_literal: "McHaAg^.Wow, a dinner meeting with the commissioner! This could be great."

translation: Wow, kolacja z panią komisarz! To może być świetna okazja.

source_text: I wonder what this opportunity could be.

structure.raw_value: McFrDe^.I wonder what this opportunity could be.
structure.script_literal: "McFrDe^.I wonder what this opportunity could be."

translation: Ciekawe, co to za okazja.

source_text: When Melissa finds out, she might be upset.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe^.When Melissa finds out, she might be upset.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe^.When Melissa finds out, she might be upset."

translation: Kiedy Melissa się dowie, może być niezadowolona.

source_text: I’ll deal with that when the time comes.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp^.I’ll deal with that when the time comes.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp^.I’ll deal with that when the time comes."

translation: Zajmę się tym, kiedy nadejdzie czas.

source_text: First, I’ll need to make a good impression on Andrea. Last time we talked, she caught me snooping around using Melissa’s login.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp^.First, I’ll need to make a good impression on Andrea. Last time we talked, she caught me snooping around using Melissa’s login.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp^.First, I’ll need to make a good impression on Andrea. Last time we talked, she caught me snooping around using Melissa’s login."

translation: Najpierw muszę zrobić dobre wrażenie na Andrei. Ostatnio gdy rozmawialiśmy, przyłapała mnie na szperaniu na loginie Melissy.

source_text: I hope I don’t screw things up.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe^.I hope I don’t screw things up.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe^.I hope I don’t screw things up."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że niczego nie spieprzę.

source_text: I should go prepared. A nice outfit and a bottle of wine is sure to impress.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe^.I should go prepared. A nice outfit and a bottle of wine is sure to impress.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe^.I should go prepared. A nice outfit and a bottle of wine is sure to impress."

translation: Powinienem się przygotować. Szykowny strój i butelka wina na pewno zrobią wrażenie.

source_text: Time to go shopping.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp^.Time to go shopping.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp^.Time to go shopping."

translation: Czas na zakupy.

source_text: The damn security guard took my belt buckle just because it was made of metal.

structure.raw_value: NPC.The damn security guard took my belt buckle just because it was made of metal.
structure.script_literal: "NPC.The damn security guard took my belt buckle just because it was made of metal."

translation: Cholerny ochroniarz zabrał mi klamrę od paska tylko dlatego, że była metalowa.

source_text: Wow! You found my belt buckle! My pants will finally stay up! Take this reward.

structure.raw_value: NPC.Wow! You found my belt buckle! My pants will finally stay up! Take this reward.
structure.script_literal: "NPC.Wow! You found my belt buckle! My pants will finally stay up! Take this reward."

translation: Wow! Znalazłeś moją klamrę! W końcu spodnie nie będą spadać! Weź tę nagrodę.

source_text: Feeling ready?

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Feeling ready?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Feeling ready?"

translation: Gotowy?

source_text: I’m ready for it, Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’m ready for it, Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’m ready for it, Andrea."

translation: Jestem gotowy, Andreo.

source_text: Commissioner Kimura while we’re on the clock.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Commissioner Kimura while we’re on the clock.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Commissioner Kimura while we’re on the clock."

translation: Pani komisarz Kimura, gdy jesteśmy na służbie.

source_text: Oh, yeah. Right. Sorry.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Oh, yeah. Right. Sorry.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Oh, yeah. Right. Sorry."

translation: Och, tak. Jasne. Przepraszam.

source_text: Come with me. We’ll discuss everything in the interrogation room.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Come with me. We’ll discuss everything in the interrogation room.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Come with me. We’ll discuss everything in the interrogation room."

translation: Chodź ze mną. Omówimy wszystko w pokoju przesłuchań.

source_text: 1Hero! There you are.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.1Hero! There you are.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.1Hero! There you are."

translation: 1Hero! Jesteś.

source_text: Sorry, Miss Kimura. I was out of the office this afternoon.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.Sorry, Miss Kimura. I was out of the office this afternoon.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.Sorry, Miss Kimura. I was out of the office this afternoon."

translation: Przepraszam, panno Kimura. Nie było mnie w biurze dziś po południu.

source_text: Did you watch the segment?

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Did you watch the segment?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Did you watch the segment?"

translation: Oglądałeś segment?

source_text: Yeah. Looked pretty good to me.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Yeah. Looked pretty good to me.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Yeah. Looked pretty good to me."

translation: Tak. Wyglądał całkiem nieźle.

source_text: It was perfect. You did great.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.It was perfect. You did great.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.It was perfect. You did great."

translation: Był idealny. Spisałeś się świetnie.

source_text: I’m glad to hear that… but…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I’m glad to hear that… but…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I’m glad to hear that… but…"

translation: Cieszę się… ale…

source_text: I heard about what happened at the Wilkes’ mansion.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.I heard about what happened at the Wilkes’ mansion.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.I heard about what happened at the Wilkes’ mansion."

translation: Słyszałem o tym, co stało się w rezydencji Wilkesów.

source_text: So... What do we tell the public?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.So... What do we tell the public?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.So... What do we tell the public?"

translation: Więc… Co mówimy opinii publicznej?

source_text: We have to keep this under wraps.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.We have to keep this under wraps.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.We have to keep this under wraps."

translation: Musimy zachować to w tajemnicy.

source_text: Lots of officers witnessed what happened.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Lots of officers witnessed what happened.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Lots of officers witnessed what happened."

translation: Wielu funkcjonariuszy było świadkami tego, co się wydarzyło.

source_text: Everyone is convinced that it was a robbery attempt.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Everyone is convinced that it was a robbery attempt.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Everyone is convinced that it was a robbery attempt."

translation: Wszyscy są przekonani, że to była próba rabunku.

source_text: This doesn’t have to tie back to the Guild.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.This doesn’t have to tie back to the Guild.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.This doesn’t have to tie back to the Guild."

translation: Nie musi się to wiązać z Gildią.

source_text: I know who Nellie is… She was there.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I know who Nellie is… She was there.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I know who Nellie is… She was there."

translation: Wiem, kim jest Nellie… Była tam.

source_text: 1Hero, you have a specific job. The rest you must trust me with.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.1Hero, you have a specific job. The rest you must trust me with.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.1Hero, you have a specific job. The rest you must trust me with."

translation: 1Hero, masz konkretne zadanie. Resztę musisz zostawić mnie.

source_text: Then let me ask you. Should I ignore Nellie or should I arrest her?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Then let me ask you. Should I ignore Nellie or should I arrest her?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Then let me ask you. Should I ignore Nellie or should I arrest her?"

translation: Więc zapytam. Mam ignorować Nellie, czy ją aresztować?

source_text: If you suspect someone is with the Guild…

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.If you suspect someone is with the Guild…
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.If you suspect someone is with the Guild…"

translation: Jeśli podejrzewasz, że ktoś jest z Gildii…

source_text: Leave them alone and do not interfere.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Leave them alone and do not interfere.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Leave them alone and do not interfere."

translation: Zostaw ich w spokoju i nie wtrącaj się.

source_text: Okay, Miss Kimura. You can trust me…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Okay, Miss Kimura. You can trust me…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Okay, Miss Kimura. You can trust me…"

translation: Dobrze, panno Kimura. Może mi pani ufać…

source_text: But I will do what I must to keep Lillian safe.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.But I will do what I must to keep Lillian safe.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.But I will do what I must to keep Lillian safe."

translation: Ale zrobię, co muszę, by zapewnić Lillian bezpieczeństwo.

source_text: She’s safe. The officers will keep guard over her mansion.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.She’s safe. The officers will keep guard over her mansion.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.She’s safe. The officers will keep guard over her mansion."

translation: Jest bezpieczna. Funkcjonariusze będą pilnować jej rezydencji.

source_text: I can’t help but feel the need to investigate further. Is there anything I can do?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I can’t help but feel the need to investigate further. Is there anything I can do?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I can’t help but feel the need to investigate further. Is there anything I can do?"

translation: Nie mogę się oprzeć potrzebie dalszego śledztwa. Czy mogę coś zrobić?

source_text: Don’t you have other cases?

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Don’t you have other cases?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Don’t you have other cases?"

translation: Nie masz innych spraw?

source_text: Your focus with the Guild is public relations. If you have the itch to solve crime, then work on your other cases.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Your focus with the Guild is public relations. If you have the itch to solve crime, then work on your other cases.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Your focus with the Guild is public relations. If you have the itch to solve crime, then work on your other cases."

translation: Twoim zadaniem w Gildii jest PR. Jeśli swędzi cię, by rozwiązywać przestępstwa, zajmij się innymi sprawami.

source_text: Shit. Why won't she just let me be a part of the undercover team?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe^.Shit. Why won't she just let me be a part of the undercover team?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe^.Shit. Why won't she just let me be a part of the undercover team?"

translation: Cholera. Dlaczego po prostu nie pozwoli mi być częścią zespołu pod przykrywką?

source_text: I’d make for a great spy!...

structure.raw_value: McHaOp^.I’d make for a great spy!...
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp^.I’d make for a great spy!..."

translation: Byłbym świetnym szpiegiem!...

source_text: I think.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe^.I think.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe^.I think."

translation: Chyba.

source_text: Heh… Maybe I am too cocky.

structure.raw_value: McFlOpNo4^.Heh… Maybe I am too cocky.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOpNo4^.Heh… Maybe I am too cocky."

translation: Heh… Może jestem zbyt zarozumiały.

source_text: Smooth moves, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BoFlOp.Smooth moves, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BoFlOp.Smooth moves, 1Hero."

translation: Gładka akcja, 1Hero.

source_text: Shut up, Bobby.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Shut up, Bobby.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Shut up, Bobby."

translation: Zamknij się, Bobby.

source_text: Did something fall down to the first floor?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Did something fall down to the first floor?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Did something fall down to the first floor?"

translation: Czy coś spadło na parter?

source_text: 1Hero!?

structure.raw_value: BoShOpNo1.1Hero!?
structure.script_literal: "BoShOpNo1.1Hero!?"

translation: 1Hero!?

source_text: Are you stealing stuff from the office?

structure.raw_value: BoAnAg.Are you stealing stuff from the office?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnAg.Are you stealing stuff from the office?"

translation: Kradniesz rzeczy z biura?

source_text: What the hell is this? Looks like old mint-flavored chewing gum in an ashtray.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What the hell is this? Looks like old mint-flavored chewing gum in an ashtray.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.What the hell is this? Looks like old mint-flavored chewing gum in an ashtray."

translation: Co to, do cholery, jest? Wygląda jak stara guma miętowa w popielniczce.

source_text: Why would a cat try to eat chewing gum?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Why would a cat try to eat chewing gum?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Why would a cat try to eat chewing gum?"

translation: Po co kot miałby jeść gumę do żucia?

source_text: Hey! Get back! That thing might have rabies.

structure.raw_value: OcWoAg.Hey! Get back! That thing might have rabies.
structure.script_literal: "OcWoAg.Hey! Get back! That thing might have rabies."

translation: Hej! Cofnij się! To coś może mieć wściekliznę.

source_text: Somehow a cat got into the building.

structure.raw_value: OcWoEx.Somehow a cat got into the building.
structure.script_literal: "OcWoEx.Somehow a cat got into the building."

translation: Jakoś kot dostał się do budynku.

source_text: Can’t you just grab it?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Can’t you just grab it?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Can’t you just grab it?"

translation: Nie możesz go po prostu złapać?

source_text: That’s not my area of expertise.

structure.raw_value: OcAnEx.That’s not my area of expertise.
structure.script_literal: "OcAnEx.That’s not my area of expertise."

translation: To nie moja działka.

source_text: Shit! It’s heading for the meeting rooms!

structure.raw_value: OcWoAg.Shit! It’s heading for the meeting rooms!
structure.script_literal: "OcWoAg.Shit! It’s heading for the meeting rooms!"

translation: Cholera! Kieruje się do salek konferencyjnych!

source_text: Whatever shall we do?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Whatever shall we do?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Whatever shall we do?"

translation: Cóż mamy począć?

source_text: Did you find the cat?

structure.raw_value: OcBaOp.Did you find the cat?
structure.script_literal: "OcBaOp.Did you find the cat?"

translation: Znalazłeś kota?

source_text: I got it! Turns out it was attracted to mint. Can you believe that?
